us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump heads to Alaska as Senate race tightens
bullets: Trump scheduled an Alaska trip ahead of the midterm elections.
AP reported the visit signals a competitive Senate race.
State Republicans continue criticizing ranked-choice voting rules.

articles.title: Federal judge halts work on historic D.C. golf course for one day
bullets: A judge ordered a one-day pause on renovation work.
The dispute involves tree-cutting at a historic Washington golf course.
Plaintiffs are challenging Trump administration renovation plans.

articles.title: U.S. Army showcases quieter Rio Grande after border troop surge
bullets: AP visited a Rio Grande area after the troop increase.
Officials described quieter conditions along that stretch.
Critics questioned whether the deployment is policy or political theater.

articles.title: Storm flood risk eases in southwestern U.S. after heavy rain
bullets: Pacific storms brought flooding concerns to the U.S. Southwest.
Las Vegas tied an October daily rainfall record.
Mexico reported five deaths from the same weather systems.

articles.title: Judge blocks taxpayer-funded campaign-style ads, roundup reports
bullets: A headlines roundup cited a Washington Post report on the ruling.
The dispute involved administration ads funded by taxpayers.
The case comes weeks before the November midterms.
articles.source: Mueller, She Wrote / Washington Post roundup

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel kill five in Mexico
bullets: The storms struck Mexico’s Pacific coast.
Authorities reported five deaths and infrastructure damage.
Rescuers used helicopters after flash flooding.

articles.title: Argentina temporarily closes Iguazu Falls after water surge
bullets: Argentina closed access to Iguazu Falls temporarily.
The closure followed an El Niño-fueled rise in water levels.
Officials cited safety concerns at the tourist site.

articles.title: U.S. hopes Russian diesel deal can soften Moscow on Ukraine talks
bullets: Reuters reported U.S. envoys briefed Ukrainian officials in Miami.
The diesel deal is intended to restart talks with Russia.
Sources said Putin was not ready for sustained negotiations.

articles.title: Afghan authorities suspend BBC radio broadcasts, broadcaster says
bullets: Afghan authorities suspended BBC radio broadcasts nationwide.
Reuters reported the broadcaster confirmed the action.
The move affects radio access across Afghanistan.

articles.title: Two ships hit by drones in Black Sea; one sank, Bulgaria says
bullets: Bulgaria’s prime minister said two ships were struck.
Euronews reported one vessel sank after the drone attacks.
Details on cargo and origin were not immediately provided.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Opposition asks Supreme Court to probe Election Commission decisions
bullets: Opposition leaders filed a joint plea in the Supreme Court.
They sought scrutiny of Election Commission decisions.
The plea also requested an audit of SIR voter deletions.

articles.title: Anti-CEC protests continue as Rahul Gandhi hosts opposition outreach
bullets: Rahul Gandhi invited INDIA bloc MPs and civil society members.
Opposition groups continued protests over electoral irregularities claims.
Jantar Mantar remained the focal protest site.

articles.title: Kerala Mini Cooper crash case expands with more arrests
bullets: Three more people were arrested after the crash.
Police said the 19-year-old driver allegedly drank before driving.
Families of victims demanded harsher punishment.

articles.title: Cheetah cub born to Namibian mother found dead at Kuno
bullets: The cub belonged to Aasha, a Namibian cheetah.
It was part of India’s cheetah reintroduction programme.
Officials reported the cub’s death at Kuno National Park.

articles.title: Arunachal hydel project faces protests amid China dam concerns
bullets: The 11,200-MW Siang Upper Hydel Project faces local opposition.
Protesters fear livelihood and cultural losses.
The issue is linked to concerns over China’s upstream dam plans.
articles.source: CurrentAffairsAI / The Hindu / Indian Express roundup

articles.title: U.S. stocks mixed as big banks report earnings
bullets: Wall Street traded mixed early Tuesday.
Major U.S. banks began reporting quarterly results.
Chip stocks weakened again in early trading.

articles.title: Micron slips as chip stocks fall again
bullets: AP reported Micron fell about 3% premarket.
Nvidia, Broadcom and Qualcomm also dipped.
The moves followed renewed pressure on semiconductor shares.

articles.title: AI chip selloff pressures Nvidia, Broadcom and Qualcomm
bullets: Chip shares weakened before the market open.
Nvidia, Broadcom and Qualcomm each dipped around 1%.
Investors weighed AI spending concerns and earnings risk.

articles.title: Indexes hover near records after mixed Monday session
bullets: Stocks finished mixed Monday on Wall Street.
AP said the market stayed near last week’s all-time high.
Investors awaited earnings and economic data.

articles.title: Dollar slips as oil retreats and Fed focus returns
bullets: Reuters reported the dollar slipped from 18-month highs.
Oil prices fell as traders assessed possible Russian diesel supply.
Markets awaited September CPI data due Wednesday.

articles.title: JPMorgan, Goldman, Citi and Wells Fargo kick off bank earnings
bullets: Major U.S. banks report results Tuesday.
Investors are watching credit quality and trading revenue.
The reports start a busy earnings week.

articles.title: Johnson & Johnson and UnitedHealth earnings in focus
bullets: Reuters listed both companies among Tuesday earnings reports.
Healthcare results arrive during broader market uncertainty.
Investors are watching guidance and cost trends.

articles.title: IMF warns conflicts and technology shifts are widening disparities
bullets: A Reuters press digest summarized the IMF warning.
The report cited high energy costs and rapid technological disruption.
The IMF said gains are deepening divides between countries.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times press digest via SquawkNews

articles.title: Musk becomes largest known donor of U.S. midterm cycle, digest says
bullets: A Reuters digest cited New York Times reporting.
Musk reportedly donated more than $276 million since July.
The funds went to Republican groups and his super PAC.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times press digest via SquawkNews

articles.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11 and plans Disney asset sale
bullets: Techmeme cited Reuters reporting on the bankruptcy filing.
Character.AI agreed to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million.
The company plans to keep operating during the sale.

articles.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 AI chip to reduce Nvidia dependence
bullets: Microsoft unveiled its latest custom AI accelerator.
Axios reported deployment is planned for 2027.
The chip targets inference for Microsoft products and services.

articles.title: Meta unveils new Muse Wonder AI models
bullets: A Reuters digest cited Meta’s new flagship AI models.
The models are named Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full.
Meta is working to narrow gaps with AI rivals.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times press digest via SquawkNews

articles.title: Nvidia’s China AI-chip share falls as Huawei closes gap
bullets: IDC data cited by Reuters showed Nvidia’s China share fell to 34%.
Shipments reportedly dropped 44% year over year in H1 2026.
U.S. export curbs and domestic competition pressured Nvidia.

articles.title: Global chip selloff deepens after AI spending warning
bullets: Financial Times reporting cited a sharp chip-stock selloff.
Samsung and SK Hynix fell heavily in Asian trading.
Broadcom’s CEO compared AI investing risks to a casino.

articles.title: India reviews Starlink entry as security assessment continues
bullets: A current-affairs roundup said Starlink’s India entry remains under review.
All three licensees are at the same regulatory stage.
Security assessment is a key step before launch.
articles.source: CurrentAffairsAI / The Hindu / Indian Express roundup
